rows.note: This is the all-purpose verb for treating someone with great respect and deference.

example.english: I venerate that teacher and often seek his advice.
example.traditional: 我好尊敬嗰位老師，成日都向佢請教。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zyun1 ging3 go2 wai6 lou5 si1 seng4 jat6 dou1 hoeng3 keoi5 cing2 gaau3
